title: The Exception That Became a Principle
fact_notes: 人物・出来事・制度は架空の教材例・思考実験。実在の調査・統計・実証結果や学校規則ではない。制作台帳は来歴確認用。

sentences.en: Suppose a fictional school has created a rule requiring students to submit a particular assignment before the beginning of the next lesson.
sentences.ja: 架空の学校が特定課題を次の授業開始前に提出する規則を作ったとしよう。

sentences.en: The teacher explains that a common deadline allows time for reviewing everyone's work and preparing a discussion based on their responses.
sentences.ja: 共通の期限で全員の課題を確認し回答に基づく議論を準備できると教師は説明する。

sentences.en: One student requests an extension because an unexpected family responsibility has prevented her from completing the assignment according to the original schedule.
sentences.ja: 予期しない家族の責任で当初の日程どおり課題を終えられなかった生徒が延長を求める。

sentences.en: Several classmates argue that granting an exception would be unfair to those who made considerable efforts to meet the established deadline.
sentences.ja: 例外を認めると既定の期限を守るためかなり努力した人に不公平だと級友の数人が主張する。

sentences.en: The teacher acknowledges the importance of predictable rules but asks the class to consider what fairness means in relation to the purpose of this particular assignment.
sentences.ja: 予測可能な規則の重要性を認めつつ、この課題の目的との関係で公平が何を意味するか考えるよう求める。

sentences.en: If the assignment is intended primarily to provide an opportunity to practice a skill, a limited extension might allow a student to demonstrate the intended learning despite a temporary difficulty.
sentences.ja: 課題が主に技能練習の機会を提供する目的なら限定的延長で一時的困難にもかかわらず意図した学びを示せるかもしれない。

sentences.en: However, postponing submission could also affect the preparation of the next lesson, particularly if the assignment contains information that other students will need during the planned discussion.
sentences.ja: しかし提出延期は次の授業準備にも影響し得る。特に予定の議論で他の生徒が必要とする情報を課題が含む場合だ。

sentences.en: The issue therefore cannot be resolved merely by declaring that exceptions are always compassionate or that identical treatment is always fair.
sentences.ja: 例外は常に思いやりがあるとか同一扱いは常に公平だと宣言するだけでは解決できない。

sentences.en: The teacher decides to establish general conditions under which an alternative deadline may be considered instead of making a judgment based solely on personal sympathy for a particular student.
sentences.ja: 特定生徒への個人的同情だけで判断せず別の期限を検討できる一般条件を定めることにする。

sentences.en: Students who experience an unexpected difficulty will be able to request a reasonable adjustment through a private conversation, without having to disclose personal circumstances to the entire class.
sentences.ja: 予期しない困難を経験した生徒は個人的事情を全員に明かすことなく個別の会話で合理的な調整を求められるようにする。

sentences.en: The teacher will examine whether the proposed adjustment preserves the central learning objective and whether any arrangements are needed to avoid unnecessary disadvantages for other participants.
sentences.ja: 提案調整が中心学習目標を維持するか、他の参加者への不要な不利益を避ける手配が要るか調べる。

sentences.en: These conditions are communicated to the class in advance, although the details of individual decisions are not made public merely to demonstrate that the procedure has been followed.
sentences.ja: 条件は事前にクラスに伝えるが、手順を守ったと示すためだけに個別判断の詳細は公開しない。

sentences.en: Some students remain concerned that a flexible policy might encourage people to postpone work that they could have completed earlier.
sentences.ja: 柔軟な方針はもっと早く終えられた作業を延期するよう促すのではないかと懸念する生徒もいる。

sentences.en: The teacher considers this possibility and recognizes that an adjustment process must be manageable as well as sensitive to individual circumstances.
sentences.ja: この可能性を考え、調整手続きには個別事情への配慮と運用可能性の両方が必要と認識する。

sentences.en: She proposes reviewing the policy after a limited period, examining whether it has allowed students to participate in the intended learning without creating unreasonable administrative demands.
sentences.ja: 限定期間後に見直し、過度の事務負担を生まず生徒が意図した学びに参加できたか調べることを提案する。

sentences.en: She does not claim that a single fictional classroom procedure can resolve every conflict between consistent expectations and differences in people's circumstances.
sentences.ja: 一つの架空の教室手順で一貫した期待と人々の事情の違いのあらゆる衝突を解決できるとは主張しない。

sentences.en: The thought experiment illustrates that a defensible exception need not be an abandonment of the general principle behind a rule.
sentences.ja: この思考実験は正当化できる例外が規則の背後の一般原則の放棄である必要はないと示す。

sentences.en: Sometimes an exception makes that principle more explicit by revealing the conditions under which a standard procedure may fail to achieve its intended purpose.
sentences.ja: 例外は標準手順が目的を達成できない条件を明らかにすることでその原則をより明示する場合もある。

sentences.en: Fairness requires more than an agreement to be generous, since different decisions should also be open to explanation in terms that people in comparable circumstances could reasonably understand.
sentences.ja: 公平には寛大にすると合意する以上のことが必要だ。異なる判断も同様の事情の人が合理的に理解できる言葉で説明可能であるべきだからだ。

sentences.en: The challenge is to develop a practice that is sufficiently consistent to guide expectations while remaining capable of responding to relevant differences without treating them as arbitrary reasons for preferential treatment.
sentences.ja: 課題は期待を導く十分な一貫性を持ちつつ、関連する違いをえこひいきの恣意的理由と扱わず対応できる実践を作ることだ。

able to be supported by reasons

questions.prompt: Why was a common deadline established?
options: To punish students with family responsibilities.
To allow review and lesson preparation.

questions.prompt: Why did classmates object to an extension?
options: They had already been offered identical extensions.
They felt their own efforts to meet the deadline mattered.
questions.explanation_ja: 期限を守った努力への公平性。

questions.prompt: What could justify a limited extension?
options: Allowing the intended learning despite a temporary difficulty.

questions.prompt: Why consider the needs of other students?
options: A delayed assignment may affect shared lesson preparation.
Every adjustment is harmless by definition.
The original deadline has no purpose.
questions.explanation_ja: 他の生徒の活動にも影響。

questions.prompt: How can students request an adjustment?
options: By publicly disclosing every personal detail.
Through a class vote on their family situation.
To guarantee all requests are approved.
To make the process secret in every respect.
To make adjustments principled rather than dependent only on sympathy.
To remove the teacher's ability to consider learning.
questions.explanation_ja: 個人的同情だけに頼らない。

options: No student could meet a deadline.
The class had no common goals.

questions.prompt: Why review after a limited period?
options: To prove the policy works universally.
To examine learning benefits and operational burdens.
Lacking a good reason or consistent basis.
Consistent rules and justified adjustments should both serve relevant purposes.
questions.explanation_ja: 一貫性と正当な調整を両立。

grammar.focus: instead of making a judgment based solely on personal sympathy

paraphrases.explanation_ja: 期限を守った努力への懸念。

paraphrases.rewrite: An extension may let a learner demonstrate the target skill even when a temporary obstacle interferes.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 一時的困難があっても技能を示す。

paraphrases.rewrite: The teacher chooses general criteria rather than relying only on sympathy for one student.

paraphrases.rewrite: A defensible practice must be consistent enough to guide people yet flexible enough to address relevant differences.
